{{Quote|I had my moment of doubt. I saw Keighlah, Perrin and Bann die because of it.|Barden Golah|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Bann''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Imperial Reclamation Service]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. He was a member of [[Darth Silthar]] and [[Barden Golah]]'s team that [[Reclamation Service Tatooine expedition|uncovered]] the [[The Imprisoned One's mind prison]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Alongside [[Keighlah]] and [[Perrin (Imperial Reclamation Service)|Perrin]], he got infected by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] device and had to be put down. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Golah later lamented his [[Death/Legends|death]].
